text:
Seedbed seeding rate is given for two seed-density options: a higher-density option uses 20-30 kg of seed per hectare (equivalent to 40 g per square meter), and a lower-density option uses 10-15 kg of seed per hectare (equivalent to 25 g per square meter). Note: the slide labels these two rates with a short Khmer term that was not fully legible in the source image (possibly relating to number of seedlings/seeds per unit), so the exact distinction between the two rates beyond the kg/ha and g/m2 figures could not be confirmed with confidence.

Seed soaking and incubation before sowing to the nursery bed: seeds are soaked in water for 24 hours, then kept covered/incubated for 24-36 hours before sowing (standard pre-germination treatment).

Seedbed fertilization: compost or cow manure is applied at 50-100 kg per 100 square meters of nursery bed; chemical fertilizer 15-15-15 is applied at 1 kg per 100 square meters.

Sowing practice: seed should be sown so that it does not get buried/sunk into the mud.

Water management on the seedbed: keep the seedbed moderately moist; do not let water pool/stand on it.
